sources.quote:
Our latest flagship `Grok 3` models are now generally available via
the API. For more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: xAI release notes place general API availability of Grok 3 models in April 2025, but give no price or price-effective date.

sources.quote: Cached tokens are billed at the **cached prompt token price**, which is substantially lower than the regular prompt token price. The exact rates vary by model — check the [Pricing](/developers/pricing) page for current prices.
sources.supports: xAI documents reduced billing for cached prompt tokens, but does not state that Grok 3 mini had no separately-priced cache writes during the earlier period.

notes: The available provider documentation establishes Grok 3 API availability and describes cached-token pricing generally, but provides no historical Grok 3 mini rates and does not establish whether the earlier cache_write value was ever official. The Internet Archive CDX/snapshot request was unavailable (503/429), so there is no provider snapshot pair to bracket a change; classification and effective date remain unclear.
